''See also: [[Enosh Travelers Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The [[Enosh]] [[Travelers]] are a group originating from the territory of [[Enosh]]. They possess the ability to utilize [[Gates]] for travel and are overseen by [[Grandmasters]] who control specific waypoints, such as those found in [[Naraka]]. Historically, these [[Travelers]] played a role in maintaining the stability of their territories by managing roads and waystations and suppressing wild elements, which allowed for occasional trade with others. However, their behavior has become increasingly aggressive over time. They are described by some as a cult dedicated to the [[Incarnations]] with intentions of global [[destruction]]. In military contexts, they have been known to cause chaos by emerging from [[Gates]] to strike targets before retreating to their own lands. While they are distinct from other groups like the [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] or [[Lirial Travelers]], they operate under a King and are currently involved in preparations for war.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Driven by a goal to destroy [[The Tree|the Tree]], the [[Enosh]] [[Travelers]] were responsible for the death of [[Simon]]'s father. These group members utilized spinning, wheel-like floating crystals for transport and maintained a respectful demeanor toward [[Alin]]. During [[Valin]]'s address to the people, both the travelers and the soldiers remained silent. While [[the Nye]] followed them in attacking anyone wearing a [[Damascan]] uniform, the majority of the [[Enosh]] [[Travelers]] eventually fled or died. Ultimately, those who remained filed through the Gate into the [[Crimson Vault]].}}
